items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: I’ve got guys like Randy Brecker wants to do one, Dave Taylor, Danny Gottlieb on drums.

ctx.x: Something like that. That’s it, yeah. That’s it. But I mean I love doing it. I mean I don’t foresee using it — you know I’m trying to do this eleven piece band for like it feels like an eternity. I’m doing all the stuff for this orchestra and that orchestra and my wife has been bugging me. I’ve been wanting to put this eleven piece band together. So I’ve got like two charts written in three years. Not a great start. And it’s been funny with me because I have gigs offered to me, and I have guys like Randy Brecker…
You better book a gig. See because you need to get panicked.
